mechanism.claim: A synchronized London-to-New-York handoff in which JPY and CHF weaken while MXN and AUD strengthen identifies a global risk-on repricing; the exact opposite identifies risk-off. In elevated BTC variation, follow this cross-sectional FX barbell direction in BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: same as canonical FX risk direction: long for safe-haven weakness plus cyclical strength, short for the reverse
mechanism.why_distinct: Dollar breadth measures a common USD direction across major pairs. This candidate instead cancels the common dollar factor by requiring opposite canonical signs between two safe-haven and two cyclical currencies during a different fixed session. Directed FX propagation and synchronization use temporal or broad co-movement structures, not this predeclared safe-haven/cyclical barbell. It uses no BTC return direction, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing BTC 24-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one fixed weekday cross-sectional FX barbell decision at 13:00 UTC is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: exact observed bars_polygon one-minute rows during weekday [07:00,13:00) UTC
features.session_valid: per pair at least 330 distinct minutes, first no later than 07:05, last no earlier than 12:55, finite positive OHLC; no imputation
features.pair_zscores: each canonical return standardized against at most 90 strictly prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; prior sample std strict positive
features.barbell_gate: at least three of four qualifying pair z-scores share one strict sign and no qualifying pair has the opposite sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 prior valid weekday decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 13:00 UTC after the FX session and BTC variation are complete
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual D 13:05 UTC open
clock.side: same as canonical FX risk direction
clock.reservation: fixed weekday decisions; global chronological half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-sectional FX risk-factor cancellation mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no pair universe, session, validity, standardization, z threshold, breadth, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
